definition: II. קִיר in proper name, of a location of Moabite cities (compare קר = city MI 11, 12, 24 , plural קרן Jer 1:29 ); — ᵐ5 usually omitted, or reads τὸ τεῖχος ; — 1. מוֺאָב ׳ ק Isa 15:1 , possibly Rabba , south of Arnon, see Buhl Geogr.270. 2. חֶ֫רֶשׂ ׳ ק Jer 48:31 ; Jer 48:36 , חָ֑רֶשׂ ׳ ק Isa 16:11 = חֲרֶ֫שֶׂת ׳ ק Isa 16:7 , חֲדָ֑שֶׂת ׳ ק 2Kgs 3:25 ( Gi חֲרָ֑שֶׁת ׳ ק ), perhaps Kerak , south of Rabba, see Buhl lb., and compare (on Kerak) Palmer Des. of Ex. ii. 472 Dowling PEQ. Oct. 1896, 327 , especially Mauss in de Luynes Voyage à la Mer Morte (1864), ii. 106 ff., iii (Atlas, near the end), 13 plural

BDB7433 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB7435

II. קִיר in proper name, of a location of Moabite cities (compare קר = city MI11, 12, 24, plural קרן Jer 1:29); — ᵐ5 usually omitted, or reads τὸ τεῖχος; —

1. מוֺאָב ׳ק Isa 15:1, possibly Rabba, south of Arnon, see BuhlGeogr.270.
2. חֶ֫רֶשׂ ׳ק Jer 48:31; Jer 48:36, חָ֑רֶשׂ ׳ק Isa 16:11 = חֲרֶ֫שֶׂת ׳ק Isa 16:7, חֲדָ֑שֶׂת ׳ק 2Kgs 3:25 (Gi חֲרָ֑שֶׁת ׳ק), perhaps Kerak, south of Rabba, see Buhllb., and compare (on Kerak) PalmerDes. of Ex. ii. 472 DowlingPEQ. Oct. 1896, 327, especially Mauss in de LuynesVoyage à la Mer Morte (1864), ii. 106 ff., iii (Atlas, near the end), 13 plural
